title: It's Written in the Cards
music: Mysterious fortune-teller film score, soft strings and a quiet music-box motif, slow, no vocals, instrumental only

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Part one.

segments.sfx: Two soft knocks on a wooden door, then the door opens, no music

segments.speaker: fortune
segments.text: Come in.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: said a voice. Jane Ross opened the door and went into a small room. There was a man sitting behind a table.

segments.speaker: jane
segments.text: Good afternoon. I want to see Madame Yolanda, the fortune-teller.

segments.speaker: fortune
segments.text: Madame Yolanda is not here today. But don't worry. I'm going to tell you about your future. What questions do you want to ask?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: said the man.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jane looked at the fortune-teller. She couldn't see him very well because the room was very dark.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Part three. He turned over the second card.

segments.sfx: One playing card flipped onto a wooden table, close and dry, no music

segments.speaker: fortune
segments.text: Mm, a house. A new house. You're going to move, very soon, to another country.

segments.speaker: jane
segments.text: But my boyfriend works here. He can't move to another country.

segments.speaker: fortune
segments.text: Let's look at the next card.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: said the fortune-teller. He turned over the third card.

segments.sfx: One playing card flipped onto a wooden table, close and dry, no music

segments.speaker: fortune
segments.text: A heart. You're going to fall in love.

segments.speaker: jane
segments.text: Who with?

segments.speaker: fortune
segments.text: Let me concentrate. I can see a tall, dark man. He's very attractive.

segments.speaker: jane
segments.text: Oh, that's Jim.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: said Jane.

segments.speaker: fortune
segments.text: Who's Jim? Your boyfriend?

segments.speaker: jane
segments.text: No. Jim is a man I met at a party last month. He's an actor, from New York. He says he's in love with me. It was his idea for me to come to Madame Yolanda.

segments.speaker: fortune
segments.text: Well, the card says that you're going to fall in love with him.

segments.speaker: jane
segments.text: Are you sure? But what about my boyfriend?

segments.speaker: fortune
segments.text: Let's look at the fourth card.

segments.sfx: One playing card flipped onto a wooden table, close and dry, no music
